question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is contemplated continually
The triple world is the object affected
The practitioner gains the power to shake it
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object described as smoke-colored is not explicitly specified in this verse
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
